[[Snowman (NPC)|Snowmen]] are the most basic type of the [[snowman|snowmen]]. They can be found in the first two groups in the [[Secret Lair of the Snowmen]].

==Notes==
*Unlike other foes outside [[Ascalon (pre-Searing)|Pre-searing Ascalon]] that can move, Snowmen do not flee recurring [[Area of Effect|AoE]] damage.
*Snowmen use a modified model of the [[Ice Golem]]s.
*The [[Frosty Tonic]] will turn you into this.
